items.fact: GERB executive committee decides not to nominate a presidential or vice-presidential candidate, first time in 20 years; no endorsement; will only consider support if asked
Borissov: will not vote for Iotova (ideological opponent); on Gyurov 'I won't do him any harm now'; nobody has asked GERB for backing
Vazrazhdane nominates party leader Kostadin Kostadinov for president, MEP Petar Volgin as running mate
24+ nomination committees; GERB and DPS (~700k voters) without candidate; runoff Iotova-Gyurov 'practically certain'

items.fact: Iotova ~1.1m votes, Gyurov ~450k (other outlets say 540k), total turnout <3m; ~half of GERB voters abstain; would not be surprised at 50%
